---
title: "VK5RDM MMDVM repeater"
---

The VK5RDM repeater is based on a Yaesu DR-1XE using an STM-DVM board with a Raspberry Pi running [Pi-Star](https://www.pistar.uk/) software.

- Output Tx **439.850 MHz**
- Input Rx **434.850 MHz** (no CTCSS)

See the [VK5RDM Australian codeplugs page](vk5rdm-codeplugs.qmd) for Australia-wide codeplugs that include VK5RDM.
